Route rain- and melt-derived runoff through separate stores

Source: R/routing_ihacres.R
route_ihacres_snow.Rd

Port of runoff_routing_snow_fun(). Total runoff is split into rain and melt portions by the share of rain vs. melt in that day's water input; rain runoff gets quick + slow stores and melt runoff a single slow store.

Usage

route_ihacres_snow(
  runoff,
  rain,
  melt,
  tau_q_rain,
  tau_s_rain,
  vs_rain,
  tau_s_melt,
  delay = 0,
  return_components = FALSE
)

Arguments

runoff, rain, melt

Numeric vectors of equal length (no NA).

tau_q_rain, tau_s_rain, vs_rain

Rain quick/slow stores.

tau_s_melt

Melt store time constant.

delay

Whole-time-step lag.

return_components

If TRUE return a tibble of components.

Details

FIX: the original computed the melt store's gain from the rain slow-store recession (alpha_s_rain) instead of the melt recession, so melt volume was not conserved whenever tau_s_melt != tau_s_rain.
